class: A confirmation page that also offered a form was taken for a form
symptom: Aristocrat (Workday), 29 September: after the Submit, 'Congratulations! We've Received Your Application!' appeared over a form to make a Candidate Home account. The agent read it as a sign-in page, never recorded the application as submitted, and went on trying to make an account.
site: Workday (Aristocrat); any site that offers an account after the application
root_cause: _site_confirms refused any page showing a form field (to stop a create-account page reading as a confirmation), and the sign-in step ran before the confirmation was ever checked.
why_tests_missed: The confirmation tests had either a plain thank-you page or a create-account page, never a confirmation with an optional account form on it.
fix: The confirmation is checked before the sign-in step on every page. A page whose words say, in the past tense, that the application was received, and do not say something is left to finish, is a confirmation even with a form on it (RECEIVED_TEXT, STILL_TO_DO_TEXT).
prevention: Decide what a page says has happened before deciding what it asks for, and test the pages that do both.
